mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (a typical easing threshold), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO are rising, or the interaction effect's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% annualized), rising consumer prices trigger expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% (annualized), or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it indicates weakening consumer demand and residential investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor market (PAYEMS) consistently indicates strong consumer spending and corporate hiring, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (characterized by slowing GDP growth), a deceleration in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 growth decelerates, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
